               elif command == 'PRINT':

                   output_lines.append(str(stack[-1]))

               elif command == 'LABEL':
                   # Just a marker, do nothing at execution time
                   pass

               elif command == 'JMP':
                   if len(parts) < 2:
                       raise ValueError(f"Line {pc+1}: JMP requires a label")
                   target = parts[1]
                   if target not in label_map:
                       raise NameError(f"Line {pc+1}: Undefined label '{target}'")
                   pc = label_map[target]

               elif command == 'JZ':

                       raise NameError(f"Line {pc+1}: Undefined label '{target}'")

                       raise RuntimeError(f"Line {pc+1}: Stack underflow (need 1 value for JZ)")

                   if val == 0:

                   target = parts[1]
                   if target not in label_map:

                   if val != 0:

               else:

           except Exception as e:
               # Re-raise with line number context already included in the exception message

       return output_lines
